texts.head: Of 100 lung cancer patients in Lapland, 18 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 12 patients a year.
texts.wait: Lapland wellbeing services county, 142 new lung cancer patients a year. Lapland's patients do not wait longer: 31.2 days from diagnosis to treatment in the Oulu university hospital area, 36.9 in Finland. Fewer are treated to cure. Estimated
